description.en: Reads up to two entries of a scripted in-match conversation's data (which characters are speaking, their message ID, motion/model info and team/order) out of an internal table, writing the results into the eight output arrays passed by the caller.
Output array; filled with the character ID/index of each speaker.
Output array; filled with each entry's message ID.
Output array; filled with each entry's motion file path.
Output array; filled with each entry's motion type.
Output array; filled with each entry's extra motion file path.
Output array; filled with each entry's extra motion name.
Output array; filled with each entry's team ID.
Output array; filled with each entry's display order.
True once the available entries (up to 2, limited by the size of the chara array) have been written into the output arrays; null if fewer than 2 arguments were given.
